description: The office is an extraordinary gallery of sublime hand drawings and exquisite models of uniquely joyous architectural projects developed over 35 years that have been exhibited regularly at the Royal Academy Summer Show and in exhibitions around the world. Drop in and the founding directors will be on hand to explain and discuss the wonderful exhibits.
